rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose modifier for something connected with history, including historical subjects and the history discipline.

example.jyutping: nei1 go3 hai6 lik6 si2 ge3 fo3 cing4

rows.note: Choose this when historical means relating to the past generally rather than specifically to the study of history.

example.english: Life in the historical past wasn't as convenient as it is now.
example.traditional: 過去嘅生活冇而家咁方便。
example.jyutping: gwo3 heoi3 ge3 sang1 wut6 mou5 ji4 gaa1 gam3 fong1 bin6

rows.jyutping: jau5 si2 sat6 gan1 geoi3 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this when stressing that something is based on recorded historical facts rather than legend or fiction.

example.english: This historical film based on recorded facts won't wildly alter the characters.
example.traditional: 呢套有史實根據嘅電影唔會亂改人物。
example.jyutping: nei1 tou3 jau5 si2 sat6 gan1 geoi3 ge3 din6 jing2 m4 wui5 lyun6 goi2 jan4 mat6

rows.jyutping: ji5 lik6 si2 wai4 bui3 ging2 ge3 N
rows.note: Choose this for a work or story that is set against a historical background.

example.english: This historical drama is usually very engaging.
example.traditional: 呢套以歷史為背景嘅劇通常好吸引。
example.jyutping: nei1 tou3 ji5 lik6 si2 wai4 bui3 ging2 ge3 kek6 tung1 soeng4 hou2 kap1 jan5
